title: Neural Defend ARCAS 290M: A Robust Foundation Model for AI-Generated Audio Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.27784v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Voice cloning now needs only seconds of audio, and detectors tuned to one dataset often fail when the generator, channel, or language changes. We introduce ARCAS 290M, Neural Defend's foundation model for detecting AI-generated audio. A single frozen production model, with no benchmark-specific fine-tuning, generalizes across text-to-speech, voice-conversion, and codec-language-model generators, telephone and Bluetooth channels, recording conditions, and languages. We evaluate it on the complete official test sets of ten public benchmarks, scoring every recording exactly as released, and against commercial systems on independent leaderboards. ARCAS 290M ranks first among all systems on the Podonos leaderboard and has the lowest equal error rate among commercial detectors on ASVspoof5. It separates real from AI-generated speech almost perfectly on ASVspoof5, SpeechFake, and ShiftySpeech, and detects nearly all AI-generated speech in Hin

translated_title: Neural Defend ARCAS 290M：一个用于AI生成音频检测的鲁棒基础模型
translated_abstract: 声音克隆现在只需要几秒钟的音频，而针对单一数据集调优的检测器在生成器、信道或语言发生变化时往往失效。我们推出了ARCAS 290M，这是Neural Defend公司用于检测AI生成音频的基础模型。作为一个单一的冻结生产模型，无需针对任何基准进行专门微调，它能够泛化到文本转语音、语音转换和编解码器语言模型等各类生成器，适应电话和蓝牙信道、各种录音条件以及不同语言。我们在十个公开基准的完整官方测试集上对其进行评估，对每个录音完全按发布时的原始状态进行评分，并在独立排行榜上与商业系统进行比较。ARCAS 290M在Podonos排行榜的所有系统中排名第一，并在ASVspoof5上拥有商业检测器中最低的等错误率。它在ASVspoof5、SpeechFake和ShiftySpeech数据集上几乎完美地区分真实语音和AI生成语音，并能检测出几乎所有的AI生成印地语语音。
tldr: ARCAS 290M是一个冻结的基础模型，无需针对特定基准微调，即可在跨生成器类型、信道条件和语言的多种场景下实现最先进的AI生成音频检测。
